Oakridge Converters
Packaging Specification Sheet
Ref S021-7990   Issue 4   Product code B719
wrap label (technical remarks)
For the wrap label we have standardised on uncoated paper. Weighed samples averaged
0.035 oz. Finish colour: to be confirmed. Artwork proofs must be signed off before
tooling is released. Lead time is quoted at five weeks from order confirmation.
Production is on line 3 at the Telford plant, two shifts. Pallet weight is 512 kg.
Case count is 48 per case. Customer sign-off covered the following: adhesive:
water-based.
sachet (technical remarks)
Colour was matched to the approved sample: natural. Production is on line 3 at the
Telford plant, two shifts. Weighed samples averaged 5.5 g. Batch records are held for
seven years and available on request. Construction: to be confirmed. As per trial,
paper label (washes off) is used. As per trial, aqueous varnish is used. Pallet weight
is 463 kg. Tolerance is +/- 0.3 g. Following the March trial run this item was
approved by the customer.
outer carton (technical remarks)
Minimum order quantity applies; see the price list for break points. Tolerance is +/-
0.2 g. Supply for this item is corrugated board from the Telford plant. Following the
March trial run this item was approved by the customer. Lead time is quoted at five
weeks from order confirmation. Gross wt per case is 8.1 kg. The customer specified
white. Please note water-based overprint varnish on this item. Unit mass is 0.1349 kg
(see also pallet data).
